classes.name: results
classes.reason: probe.write_staged does os.write then os.fsync and records fsync_ns, so the writing rank stalls until the data is durable, while the other ranks are meanwhile running their own task loop between the per-generation barriers.

classes.name: diagnostics
classes.reason: probe.write_buffered just opens, writes and closes with no fsync and no timing, so the 4 KiB payload is left in page cache to drain behind the ongoing task loop, and only the issuing rank touches its own r%d file once per (generation, task).
